MEET THE ARTIST / 모트

Motte

Motte is a Korean singer-songwriter who debuted with “Tickin’” in 2017. Her songs draw on uncertain relationships and memories, while “Don’t run away” introduced her voice to viewers of A-TEEN.

POP / OST / 2018

Don’t run away도망가지마

Official audio

View release on Apple Music ↗

Singer-songwriter Motte’s “Don’t run away” appeared on the soundtrack to the Korean web drama A-TEEN in September 2018. You can start with the song whether or not you have seen the series.

Listening note

A soundtrack can be the first place a voice becomes familiar. Here, Motte’s contribution to A-TEEN sits alongside the songs of her own singer-songwriter catalogue.
